{{Quote|Where you go, I go, Master.|Bryti|<ref name="Dark Times—A Spark Remains 4">[[Dark Times—A Spark Remains 4|''Dark Times—A Spark Remains'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Bryti''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] that served as a butler to fugitive [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kai Hudorra]] following his acquisition of [[The Lucky Twi'lek]] on [[Kestavel]]. His wide head was fitted with a [[Borg Construct Aj^6]] headband.

==Biography==
When [[Dass Jennir]], [[Beyghor Sahdett]], and the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' arrived at the casino in search of Hudorra, the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] told Bryti to provide the crew he was not speaking with with accommodations on the house. Following Sahdett's betrayal and subsequent report of Hudorra's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] status to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Bryti, along with several of Hudorra's other servants, reaffirmed that they would stand by him no matter what. Following hatching an [[Ambush at Kestavel|assassination attempt]] on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who was leading the oncoming attack personally, Bryti attended the pre-fight feast, where he served Jennir drugged [[Wine/Legends|wine]] on orders of his master. Hudorra would fall in his fight against Vader, and Jennir would awake aboard the escaping ''Uhumele'', where Bryti gave him a [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisc]] containing his master's final farewell to his old friend.
